items.t: Wells Fargo Maintains Overweight on Main Street Capital, Lowers Price Target to $59
items.sum: Wells Fargo analyst Finian O'Shea maintains Main Street Capital (NYSE:MAIN) with a Overweight and lowers the price target from $60 to $59.

items.t: MAIN Q3 2026 deep dive: investment activity slows, dividend increases amid market uncertainty
items.sum: Business development company Main Street Capital (NYSE:MAIN) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026 as sales only rose 1.9% year on year to $142.5 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.89 per share was 3% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.t: UBS Maintains Neutral on Main Street Capital, Raises Price Target to $58
items.sum: UBS analyst Melissa Wedel maintains Main Street Capital (NYSE:MAIN) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $57 to $58.
